youtube_description: 睡著學英文！這部影片收錄實用視訊通話情境對話（每兩句成一組：男聲常速 ➡ 女聲慢速 ➡ 男女連貫），從撥通問好、測試訊號、調整鏡頭麥克風、畫面卡頓重連、螢幕分享聊天，到道別掛斷與回撥約定，不用背，睡前聽就會。重複播放，讓英文自然進入你的大腦。👍 想學更多生活場景，請留言告訴我！別忘了訂閱+按讚。 #英文聽力 #睡前英文 #LearnEnglish
youtube_description_en: Learn English while you sleep! This video features practical Making a Video Call phrase pairs (each pair: male normal speed → female slow speed → combined dialogue), covering dialing, signal checks, camera and mic fixes, freezing, screen sharing, and sweet goodbyes. No memorization needed—just listen before bed and absorb naturally. If you want more real-life scenarios, leave a comment! Subscribe and like!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'm dialing you right now.
dialogue.zh: 我現在就撥給你。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes! It rang twice already.
dialogue.zh: 有！已經響過兩次了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you see the incoming call?
dialogue.zh: 你看到來電了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I see it, opening now.
dialogue.zh: 看到了，我正在接通。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It says connecting, hold on.
dialogue.zh: 畫面顯示連線中，等一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Same for me, the dots are spinning.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪm fər mi, ðə dɑts ɑr ˈspɪnɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 我這邊也是，圓點一直在轉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi! Are you on the screen?
dialogue.zh: 嗨！你的畫面出來了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Almost, my camera is starting up.
dialogue.zh: 快好了，鏡頭正在啟動。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Finally! The ringing stopped.
dialogue.zh: 太好了！鈴聲終於停了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I nearly missed it in the kitchen.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ ˈnɪrli mɪst ɪt ɪn ðə ˈkɪtʃɪn/
dialogue.zh: 我在廚房差點沒接到。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did the app ask for permission?
dialogue.zh: 程式有跳出權限請求嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, I allowed the camera and mic.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, aɪ əˈlaʊd ðə ˈkæmərə ənd mɪk/
dialogue.zh: 有，我允許了鏡頭和麥克風。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now your face just appeared!
dialogue.zh: 你的臉剛剛出現了呢！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: About time! Can I wave first?
dialogue.zh: 是呀！我可以先揮個手嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Of course! Wave big for me.
dialogue.zh: 當然哪！大大跟我揮一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hi! I'm waving with both hands.
dialogue.zh: 嗨！我用兩隻手在揮呢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Adorable! But the picture just froze.
dialogue.zh: 太可愛了！可是畫面剛剛卡住了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh no, frozen right mid-wave!
dialogue.zh: 噢不，正揮到一半被定格了！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Small freeze, don't you dare vanish.
dialogue.zh: 小卡一下，不準消失喔。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Still here! Waving even harder now.
dialogue.zh: 我在這！揮得更賣力了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The screen went black for me.
dialogue.zh: 我這邊螢幕突然黑了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mine went blank too, weird!
dialogue.zh: 我這邊也白屏了，怪了！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Try waving at the camera.
dialogue.zh: 對著鏡頭揮揮手試試。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'm waving, do you see me?
dialogue.zh: 我在揮手了，你看到了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I saw your hand move just now!
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ sɔ jɔr hænd muv dʒʌst naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 我剛剛看到你的手動了！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great, the wave connected.
dialogue.zh: 太好了，揮手成功送達。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We did it, hello over there!
dialogue.zh: 通了，另一邊的你，你好！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hello! This never gets old.
dialogue.zh: 你好！這種見面永遠看不膩。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How is the picture quality?
dialogue.zh: 畫質看起來怎麼樣？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sharp enough to count your eyelashes.
dialogue.zh: 很清楚，連你睫毛都數得清。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you hear me at all?
dialogue.zh: 你一點都聽不到我嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only crackling, let me switch wifi.
dialogue.zh: 只有雜音，我換一下無線網。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is my voice coming through clearly?
dialogue.zh: 我的聲音傳得清楚嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now yes, crystal clear.
dialogue.zh: 現在好了，一清二楚。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Much better, no more buzzing.
dialogue.zh: 好多了，沒有嗡嗡聲了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That fixed it, problem solved.
dialogue.zh: 換網有效，問題解決。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great, then the sound is done.
dialogue.zh: 太好了，聲音這一項過關。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Passed! The sound check is over.
dialogue.zh: 及格！音效測試結束。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your video is smooth and bright.
dialogue.zh: 你的畫面又流暢又明亮。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You look good too.
dialogue.zh: 你看起來也不錯呀。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now both video and audio work.
dialogue.zh: 現在影像和聲音都正常了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect combo, nothing missing.
dialogue.zh: 完美搭配，一樣都不缺。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, your voice sounds far away.
dialogue.zh: 等等，你的聲音聽起來好遠。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One second, grabbing my headphones.
dialogue.zh: 一下下，我去拿耳機。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There! Now you're right beside me.
dialogue.zh: 好了！現在你就像在我耳邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Headphones, the quiet fix, always.
dialogue.zh: 耳機這種安靜的解方，永遠有效。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your voice is warm now, by the way.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɔr vɔɪs ɪz wɔrm naʊ, baɪ ðə weɪ/
dialogue.zh: 說真的，你的聲音現在好溫暖。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Best sound compliment I've received.
dialogue.zh: 這是我收過最好的聲音誇獎。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A tiny delay, nothing serious.
dialogue.zh: 只有一點小延遲，不嚴重。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Agreed, it's barely noticeable.
dialogue.zh: 說得對，幾乎感覺不到。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's wait and see if it settles.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛts weɪt ənd si ɪf ɪt ˈsɛtəlz/
dialogue.zh: 我們再等等，看穩不穩定。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, a minute won't hurt.
dialogue.zh: 好啊，一分鐘沒關係。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It did! We're running well now.
dialogue.zh: 穩住了！現在跑得很順。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: See? Patience wins again.
dialogue.zh: 看見吧？耐心又贏了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Signal check, and we pass together!
dialogue.zh: 訊號檢查，我們一起過關！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Gold stars for both of us.
dialogue.zh: 我們兩個都拿到金星了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did I freeze just now?
dialogue.zh: 我剛剛是不是定格了？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: For half a second, then you moved.
dialogue.phonetic: /fər hæf ə ˈsɛkənd, ðɛn ju muvd/
dialogue.zh: 半秒鐘，然後你又動了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My wifi has been dropping lately.
dialogue.zh: 我的無線網最近老是斷。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mine too, right at dinner time.
dialogue.zh: 我也是，正好在吃飯的時候。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The signal bars went up again.
dialogue.zh: 訊號格數又升回來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nice, three bars feel lucky.
dialogue.zh: 不錯，三格感覺好幸運。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This router is so old now.
dialogue.zh: 這台路由器真的太舊了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: How many years have you had it?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ ˈmɛni jɪrz həv ju hæd ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 你用了好幾年啦？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Six years, but it still tries hard.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪks jɪrz, bʌt ɪt stɪl traɪz hɑrd/
dialogue.zh: 六年了，但它還很努力。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Loyal little box, but it looks tired.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈlɔɪəl ˈlɪɾəl bɑks, bʌt ɪt lʊks taɪərd/
dialogue.zh: 忠心的小盒子，不過它看起來很累了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A new router, maybe next month then.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə nu ˈraʊtər, ˈmeɪbi nɛkst mʌnθ ðɛn/
dialogue.zh: 那就也許下個月換台新的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Same plan, let's wait till then.
dialogue.zh: 同樣的打算，到時候再說。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, no rush, we manage fine.
dialogue.zh: 好，不急，我們將就得過。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right, a little lag never hurt.
dialogue.zh: 對呀，小卡頓無傷大雅。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hold on, the dog wants my phone.
dialogue.phonetic: /hoʊld ɑn, ðə dɔɡ wɑnts maɪ ˈfoʊn/
dialogue.zh: 等等，狗狗想要我的手機。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh no, is he chewing the case?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ noʊ, ɪz hi ˈtʃuɪŋ ðə keɪs/
dialogue.zh: 噢不，他在咬手機殼嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He thinks you're inside the screen.
dialogue.zh: 他以為你被關在螢幕裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's so cute, tell him hi!
dialogue.zh: 太可愛了，幫我跟牠問好！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi puppy! Yes, it's just me.
dialogue.zh: 嗨小乖！對，是我啦。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Does he calm down when you talk?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz hi kɑm daʊn wɛn ju tɔk/
dialogue.zh: 你一說話他會安靜嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now he's licking the camera lens.
dialogue.zh: 現在他在舔鏡頭了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha! Your whole picture went foggy.
dialogue.zh: 哈哈！你整個畫面都霧了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sorry, blurry nose for ten seconds!
dialogue.zh: 抱歉，十秒鐘的霧鼻子！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Worth it, what a sweet view!
dialogue.zh: 值得，好可愛的角度！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Best hello I ever got.
dialogue.zh: 這是收過最棒的問候。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He really delivered that message.
dialogue.zh: 他這問候送到位了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He never behaves on video calls.
dialogue.zh: 視訊時他從來都不乖。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Maybe he misses your voice too.
dialogue.zh: 也許他也想聽你的聲音。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pets make calls so much fun.
dialogue.zh: 有寵物在，通話特別好玩。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: True, he stole the show tonight.
dialogue.zh: 真的，今晚風頭都是他的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sorry about him! What was the question?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɑri əˈbaʊt hɪm! wʌt wʌz ðə ˈkwɛstʃən/
dialogue.zh: 抱歉牠搗亂！剛才的問題是什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You asked how I've been, that's all.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju æskt haʊ aɪv bɪn, ðæts ɔl/
dialogue.zh: 你問我最近好嗎，就這些呀。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh right! The puppy ate my question.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ raɪt! ðə ˈpʌpi eɪt maɪ ˈkwɛstʃən/
dialogue.zh: 對了！問題被小狗狗吃掉了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then ask it fresh! Here we go.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn æsk ɪt frɛʃ! hɪr wi ɡoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 那就重新問一次！來吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How have you been, seriously?
dialogue.zh: 說真的，你最近過得好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Better right now, truly I am.
dialogue.zh: 現在就好多了，真的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It's nice to see you again.
dialogue.zh: 能再見到你真好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It really is, two weeks felt long.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ˈrɪli ɪz, tu wiks fɛlt lɔŋ/
dialogue.zh: 是啊，兩週感覺好漫長。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You sound rested, for real.
dialogue.zh: 你聽起來睡飽飽的，真的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's true! Sleep has been my friend.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts tru! slip hæz bɪn maɪ frɛnd/
dialogue.zh: 是真的！睡眠一直是我的朋友。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: See? I knew those naps would help.
dialogue.phonetic: /si? aɪ nud ðoz næps wʊd hɛlp/
dialogue.zh: 看吧？我就知道你補的覺有用了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And you look great too, you know.
dialogue.phonetic: /ənd ju lʊk ɡreɪt tu, ju noʊ/
dialogue.zh: 而且你看起來也很棒，你知道嗎。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Lucky me, I'm wide awake tonight.
dialogue.zh: 我真幸運，今晚一點都不睏。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then this calm call will help.
dialogue.zh: 那這通安靜的電話剛好有助眠。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So, how is the new apartment going?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ, haʊ ɪz ði nu əˈpɑrtmənt ˈɡoʊɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 所以，新公寓住得怎麼樣？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's great, I love my new place.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts ɡreɪt, aɪ lʌv maɪ nu pleɪs/
dialogue.zh: 很棒，我愛死我的新家了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The balcony was your favorite part.
dialogue.zh: 陽台以前是你最喜歡的地方。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I sit outside every evening now.
dialogue.zh: 現在我每晚都坐到外面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Send me pictures this weekend.
dialogue.zh: 這週末寄點照片給我。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll send twenty, wait and see!
dialogue.zh: 我寄二十張，等著看吧！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did they fix the elevator yet?
dialogue.zh: 電梯修好了沒有？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes! Seven floors feel so fast now.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs! ˈsɛvən flɔrz fil soʊ fæst naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 好了！七層一下就上去了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'm happy for you, truly.
dialogue.zh: 我真心為你高興。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thanks, moving was really hard work.
dialogue.zh: 謝謝，搬家真是累壞人了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are all the boxes unpacked yet?
dialogue.zh: 紙箱都拆完了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Almost all, except one big one.
dialogue.zh: 差一個大箱子就全好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What's inside the mystery box?
dialogue.zh: 那個神祕箱子裡裝了什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Books I never finished, probably.
dialogue.zh: 大概都是我沒看完的書。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That box can wait till winter.
dialogue.zh: 那個箱子放到冬天再拆。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Agreed, it isn't going anywhere.
dialogue.zh: 同意，它又不會跑掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hey, you're a bit dark there.
dialogue.zh: 哎，你那邊畫面好暗。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Dark? How can my room be dark?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɑrk? haʊ kæn maɪ rum bi dɑrk/
dialogue.zh: 暗？我房間怎麼會暗？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The lamp is behind you again.
dialogue.zh: 台燈又在你背後了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh right, my whole face is shadow.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ raɪt, maɪ hoʊl feɪs ɪz ˈʃædoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 對哦，我整張臉都是陰影。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Come closer to the little light.
dialogue.zh: 靠近一點那個小燈。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Like this? Does that help at all?
dialogue.phonetic: /laɪk ðɪs? dʌz ðæt hɛlp ət ɔl/
dialogue.zh: 這樣嗎？有幫助一點嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Better! Now your eyes can shine.
dialogue.zh: 好多了！現在眼睛有光了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fancy lamp, simple problem, haha.
dialogue.zh: 燈雖高級，問題很簡單，哈哈。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The light really matters on video.
dialogue.zh: 視訊的時候光線真的很重要。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A face looks flat without it.
dialogue.zh: 沒光臉看起來扁扁的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My old calls were so dim.
dialogue.zh: 我以前通話畫面都暗暗的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mine too, now I keep a lamp ready.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪn tu, naʊ aɪ kip ə læmp ˈrɛdi/
dialogue.zh: 我也是，現在我隨時備著燈。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Flip your camera once for me.
dialogue.zh: 幫我把鏡頭反轉一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There, I'm showing the room view.
dialogue.zh: 好了，現在鏡頭對著房間。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, turn it toward the back wall.
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt, tɜrn ɪt təˈwɔrd ðə bæk wɔl/
dialogue.zh: 等等，轉到後面那面牆。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: This is my bookshelf wall here.
dialogue.zh: 這一面就是我的書牆。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wow, you have so many books!
dialogue.zh: 哇，你書也太多了吧！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Most of them I actually read.
dialogue.zh: 其中大部分我真的有讀過哦。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Turn it back, I want your face.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɜrn ɪt bæk, aɪ wɑnt jɔr feɪs/
dialogue.zh: 轉回來吧，我要看你的臉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Done! No more tours today.
dialogue.zh: 好！今天不帶參觀了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can your screen zoom in a bit?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn jɔr skriːn zum ɪn ə bɪt/
dialogue.zh: 你的畫面可以拉近一點嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let me try, something like this?
dialogue.zh: 我試試，像這樣嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, but too much! Slow down.
dialogue.zh: 對，可是太近了！慢一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now? This already feels close.
dialogue.zh: 現在呢？已經覺得很近了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect, stay exactly like that.
dialogue.zh: 完美，就保持這樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Got it, the zoom is locked here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑt ɪt, ðə zum ɪz lɑkt hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 收到，縮放就固定在這裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How did you find that setting?
dialogue.zh: 你怎麼找到那個設定的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pinch the screen with two fingers.
dialogue.zh: 兩指在螢幕上捏一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Easy trick, I should learn it.
dialogue.zh: 簡單的小訣竅，我該學起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Next call you can zoom on me.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɛkst kɔl ju kæn zum ɑn mi/
dialogue.zh: 下次通話換你拉近看我。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Careful, I'll zoom all night long.
dialogue.zh: 小心喔，我可以拉一整晚。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then I'll see my nose forever.
dialogue.zh: 那我就永遠只看得到大鼻子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Something's lagging on my side now.
dialogue.zh: 我這邊現在有點延遲了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You too? My picture keeps jumping.
dialogue.zh: 是嗎？我畫面也一直在跳。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let me close some background apps.
dialogue.zh: 我關掉幾個背景程式。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's what helped me last time.
dialogue.zh: 上回我就是這樣變順的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There, I killed six of them.
dialogue.zh: 好，我關掉了六個。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Six? Was your tablet that busy?
dialogue.zh: 六個？你平板開這麼多呀？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It runs faster now, yes!
dialogue.zh: 現在跑得快多了，真的！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Look, my jumps are all gone.
dialogue.zh: 你看，我這邊都不跳了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Smooth again, not one freeze now!
dialogue.zh: 又順了，一次都不卡！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The wifi here is really strong.
dialogue.zh: 我這邊的無線網真的很強。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, one less thing to fix.
dialogue.zh: 好，少一樣要修的東西。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It helps that the place is quiet.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt hɛlps ðət ðə pleɪs ɪz ˈkwaɪət/
dialogue.zh: 這裡安靜也有幫忙。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now your answer, the weekend plans!
dialogue.zh: 現在換你回答，週末的安排！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: What weekend plans? You never said.
dialogue.zh: 什麼週末安排？你沒說過呀。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I tried! It got stuck, remember?
dialogue.zh: 我試著問了！剛剛卡頓吞掉了，記得嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh no, I missed that one!
dialogue.zh: 噢不，那一句我沒收到。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's the trouble with bad lines.
dialogue.zh: 這就是訊號差的麻煩。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'm listening now, ask away!
dialogue.zh: 我現在認真聽，快問吧！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So, what are you doing this Saturday?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ, wʌt ɑr ju ˈduɪŋ ðɪs ˈsætəˌdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 那麼，你這週六要做什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nothing set yet, why, what's up?
dialogue.zh: 還沒定，怎麼了，有事嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I was just wondering, that's all.
dialogue.zh: 我就是隨口問問而已。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Well, now I'm curious too.
dialogue.zh: 嗯，現在我也好奇了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hold on, my brother's passing by.
dialogue.zh: 等一下，我弟路過這邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Say hi! I remember his dog story.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪ haɪ! aɪ rɪˈmɛmbər hɪz dɔɡ ˈstɔri/
dialogue.zh: 跟我問好啊！記得他那個狗狗故事。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hey, hold still for one second.
dialogue.zh: 嘿，站著別動一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wave at the camera, quick!
dialogue.zh: 快對著鏡頭揮手！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He waved so seriously, haha!
dialogue.zh: 他揮手揮得一本正經，哈哈！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That made my whole night.
dialogue.zh: 那一下把我一整晚都逗開了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He said hi, then hid himself.
dialogue.zh: 他問了好，就躲起來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is so like him, honestly.
dialogue.zh: 說真的，他就是這樣的人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Family always joins these calls.
dialogue.zh: 家人總愛湊進這種通話。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mine does, even the goldfish watches.
dialogue.zh: 我家也是，連金魚都在看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, private talk mode again.
dialogue.zh: 好，又回到兩人密談模式。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Finally, I have news for you.
dialogue.zh: 終於，我有消息要告訴你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: News! Tell me everything right now.
dialogue.zh: 消息！快全部告訴我。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wait first, did my video just stop?
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt fɜrst, dɪd maɪ ˈvɪdioʊ dʒʌst stɑp/
dialogue.zh: 先等一下，我的畫面剛停了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, frozen with a serious face.
dialogue.zh: 對，定格的臉還很嚴肅。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I was probably thinking hard, then.
dialogue.zh: 那應該是我在認真思考。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A serious thinker, that's new.
dialogue.zh: 愛思考的人，全新形象。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: At least frozen me looks calm.
dialogue.zh: 至少定格的我看起來很沉穩。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fair point. Should we restart the call?
dialogue.phonetic: /fɛr pɔɪnt. ʃʊd wi ˌriːˈstɑrt ðə kɔl/
dialogue.zh: 有道理。我們要不要重開通話？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not yet, tap the refresh button first.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt jɛt, tæp ðə rɪˈfrɛʃ ˈbʌtən fɜrst/
dialogue.zh: 先別，按重新整理看看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Spinning, spinning... is this helping?
dialogue.zh: 轉圈轉圈……這算有用嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I see a black screen, hang tight.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ si ə blæk skriːn, hæŋ taɪt/
dialogue.zh: 我這邊是黑屏，你再撐一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now the logo popped up again.
dialogue.zh: 現在標誌又跳出來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That means it's loading you back.
dialogue.zh: 那表示正在把你載回來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Back! Did I disappear long?
dialogue.zh: 回來啦！我離開很久嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ten seconds, nothing big missed.
dialogue.zh: 十秒而已，沒錯過什麼大事。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sorry, restarts make me nervous.
dialogue.zh: 抱歉，重開總讓我有點緊張。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No need, we're solid again now.
dialogue.zh: 不用怕，我們又穩定了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I want to hear the news already!
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɑnt tə hɪr ðə njuːz ɔlˈrɛdi/
dialogue.zh: 我已經等不及聽消息了！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Later tonight, the call's not ending yet.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈleɪtər təˈnaɪt, ðə kɔlz nɑt ˈɛndɪŋ jɛt/
dialogue.zh: 今晚稍後再說，通話又沒結束。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you show me the party video?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn ju ʃoʊ mi ðə ˈpɑrti ˈvɪdioʊ/
dialogue.zh: 能給我看看派對的影片嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course, but it's a huge file.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌv ˈkɔrs, bʌt ɪts ə hjuːdʒ faɪl/
dialogue.zh: 當然，但檔案超大。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then trim it to the best minute.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn trɪm ɪt tə ðə bɛst ˈmɪnɪt/
dialogue.zh: 那就剪出最精彩的一分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good call, that takes two taps.
dialogue.zh: 好主意，點兩下就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect, I'll wait right here.
dialogue.zh: 完美，我就在這兒等。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Done! Check your messages now.
dialogue.zh: 好了！現在看你的訊息。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The video arrived, it's so short.
dialogue.zh: 影片到了，好短哦。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I cut it twice, but it's gold.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ kʌt ɪt twaɪs, bʌt ɪts ɡoʊld/
dialogue.zh: 我狠心剪了兩輪，可每一秒都是精華。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wow, everyone looks so happy!
dialogue.zh: 哇，每個人看起來都好開心！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Watch the dog in the last part.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɑtʃ ðə dɔɡ ɪn ðə læst pɑrt/
dialogue.zh: 注意看最後那只狗狗。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The dog stole the whole video.
dialogue.zh: 風頭全被狗狗搶走了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He always does that at parties.
dialogue.zh: 他在派對上總是這樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How is the bedroom coming along?
dialogue.zh: 你的臥房佈置得怎麼樣了？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The new bed finally arrived today.
dialogue.zh: 新床今天終於送到了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you measure the room first?
dialogue.zh: 你有先量過房間尺寸嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes! It fits with an inch to spare.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs! ɪt fɪts wɪð ən ɪntʃ tə spɛr/
dialogue.zh: 有！放進去還多一吋空間。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did they carry it up easily?
dialogue.zh: 他們搬上來輕鬆嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Easy for them, tiring for me.
dialogue.zh: 他們輕鬆，我累壞了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll share my screen with you now.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl ʃɛr maɪ skriːn wɪð ju naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 我現在跟你分享我的螢幕。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, I see your little window.
dialogue.zh: 好，我看到你小小視窗了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here's my whole photo album.
dialogue.zh: 這是我完整的相簿。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The cover shot is your living room?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈkʌvər ʃɑt ɪz jɔr ˈlɪvɪŋ rum/
dialogue.zh: 封面那張是你家客廳嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, from last Sunday, tidy version.
dialogue.zh: 對，上週日拍的，整潔版。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Very tidy, was that a lucky day?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈvɛri ˈtaɪdi, wʌz ðæt ə ˈlʌki deɪ/
dialogue.zh: 真整潔，那天是運氣好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you remember the fountain photo?
dialogue.zh: 還記得那張噴泉的照片嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The silly one with the pigeon?
dialogue.zh: 那張有鴿子的搞笑照？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's the one! I'm opening it.
dialogue.zh: 就是那張！我打開了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Zoom it in, I can't see well.
dialogue.phonetic: /zum ɪt ɪn, aɪ kænt si wɛl/
dialogue.zh: 放大一點，我看不太清。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The colors look a bit faded though.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈkʌlərz lʊk ə bɪt ˈfeɪdɪd ðoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 不過顏色看起來有點褪色。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Faded? That's just a dark photo.
dialogue.zh: 褪色？那只是張暗照。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, sorry, wrong impression then.
dialogue.zh: 噢抱歉，那是我想錯了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There, now it's big and bright.
dialogue.zh: 你看，現在又大又亮了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Type that date into our chat.
dialogue.zh: 把那個日期打到我們的聊天室。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Where is the chat on my screen?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr ɪz ðə tʃæt ɑn maɪ skriːn/
dialogue.zh: 我畫面上的聊天室在哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: At the bottom, a small white line.
dialogue.phonetic: /ət ðə ˈbɑtəm, ə smɔl waɪt laɪn/
dialogue.zh: 在最下面，一條小白線。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Found it! One number at a time.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfaʊnd ɪt! wʌn ˈnʌmbər æt ə taɪm/
dialogue.zh: 找到了！一個數字一個數字打。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Slow hands, steady fingers.
dialogue.zh: 手別急，穩著點打。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It says two thousand twenty-six now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt sɛz tu ˈθaʊzənd ˈtwɛnti sɪks naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 現在打出二○二六了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect, send it right there.
dialogue.zh: 完美，就在那裡發送出去。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sent! That was teamwork, really.
dialogue.zh: 發好了！這真是團隊合作。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, now the green corner tour.
dialogue.zh: 好，接著參觀綠色角落。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wait, that's a huge plant you have!
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt, ðæts ə hjuːdʒ plænt ju hæv/
dialogue.zh: 等等，你那盆植物也太大了！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She's three years old already.
dialogue.zh: 她已經養了三年了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Three years! You keep plants alive?
dialogue.zh: 三年！你居然養得活植物？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Of course, I talk to them daily.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌv ˈkɔrs, aɪ tɔk tə ðɛm ˈdeɪli/
dialogue.zh: 當然，我每天跟它們說話。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Do they answer you back?
dialogue.zh: 它們會回你話嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Every plant answers, if you wait.
dialogue.zh: 每株植物都會回答，只要你等。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's wisdom from a leaf expert.
dialogue.zh: 這是葉子專家的智慧啊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look at these green friends here.
dialogue.zh: 看看我這些綠色朋友。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They all look so healthy and shiny.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ ɔl lʊk soʊ ˈhɛlθi ənd ˈʃaɪni/
dialogue.zh: 個個都那麼健康又有光澤。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Want a quick kitchen tour?
dialogue.zh: 要不要快速參觀廚房？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, show me your cooking corner.
dialogue.zh: 好啊，給我看看你的料理角落。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Watch out, it's messy in there.
dialogue.zh: 先說好，裡面有點亂。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Dramatic! I'll close my eyes first.
dialogue.zh: 真會做戲！我先閉上眼睛。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look, my new pot is blue.
dialogue.zh: 看，我的新鍋子是藍色的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I want one! What size is it?
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɑnt wʌn! wʌt saɪz ɪz ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 我也想要！多大尺寸？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The biggest one they had in store.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈbɪɡɪst wʌn ðeɪ hæd ɪn stɔr/
dialogue.zh: 是店內最大的那種。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Can it fit a whole soup?
dialogue.zh: 能裝下一整鍋湯嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It fits soup for six people.
dialogue.zh: 六個人的湯綽綽有餘。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A perfect pot needs a party.
dialogue.zh: 好鍋子就該配一場聚會。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll host one next month then.
dialogue.zh: 那我下個月就請一桌。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then save me a seat at it!
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn seɪv mi ə sit ət ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 那一定要給我留個位子！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You're invited, bring good bread.
dialogue.zh: 你被邀請了，帶上好麵包。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And don't forget the music.
dialogue.zh: 還有別忘了配音樂。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's stop the tour and talk.
dialogue.zh: 參觀到此為止，我們聊天吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Agreed, we've looked enough today.
dialogue.zh: 同意，今天已經看夠啦。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you watch that new series?
dialogue.zh: 那部新影劇你看了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes! I finished it in two nights.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs! aɪ ˈfɪnɪʃt ɪt ɪn tu naɪts/
dialogue.zh: 看了！我兩個晚上就追完。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So fast? I'm on episode three.
dialogue.zh: 這麼快？我才看到第三集。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sorry, no spoilers, I promise!
dialogue.zh: 抱歉，絕對不劇透，我保證！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, keep all the secrets safe.
dialogue.zh: 很好，把所有祕密守好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tell me when you reach nine.
dialogue.zh: 你看到第九集時跟我說。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So episode nine is the turning point?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ˈɛpəˌsoʊd naɪn ɪz ðə ˈtɜrnɪŋ pɔɪnt/
dialogue.zh: 所以第九集是轉折點嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I can't answer that, my lips are sealed.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ kænt ˈænsər ðæt, maɪ lɪps ɑr sild/
dialogue.zh: 我不能回答，我嘴緊著呢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mysterious! Fine, I'll find out.
dialogue.zh: 好神祕！行，我自己看。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Watch it with the lights low.
dialogue.zh: 記得燈轉暗再觀看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Any good movies out now?
dialogue.zh: 最近有什麼好看的電影嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only one, about a talking bear.
dialogue.zh: 就一部，關於一會說話的熊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A talking bear, really?
dialogue.zh: 會說話的熊，真的假的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Kids love it, don't judge me.
dialogue.zh: 小孩超愛，別笑我哦。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Never judge! I'd watch it with you.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnɛvər dʒʌdʒ! aɪd wɑtʃ ɪt wɪð ju/
dialogue.zh: 絕不笑你！我很願意陪你看。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Deal, a screen-share movie night!
dialogue.zh: 成交，約個螢幕同步電影夜！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So! What was that big news?
dialogue.zh: 對了！那個大消息是什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The studio is hiring, and I applied.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈstudioʊ ɪz ˈhaɪərɪŋ, ənd aɪ əˈplaɪd/
dialogue.zh: 那間工作室在招人，我應徵了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The art studio? For real this time?
dialogue.phonetic: /ði ɑrt ˈstudioʊ? fər rɪl ðɪs taɪm/
dialogue.zh: 是藝術工作室嗎？這次是真的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: For real, they called me yesterday!
dialogue.zh: 真的，他們昨天打電話來了！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's wonderful, how did it go?
dialogue.zh: 太好了，談得怎麼樣？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It went well, they asked about my drawings.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt wɛnt wɛl, ðeɪ æskt əˈbaʊt maɪ ˈdrɔɪŋz/
dialogue.zh: 很順利，他們問了我的畫作。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'm so proud of you, you know?
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪm soʊ praʊd əv ju, ju noʊ/
dialogue.zh: 我真為你驕傲，你知道嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Save the big praise for cake day!
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪv ðə bɪɡ preɪz fər keɪk deɪ/
dialogue.zh: 誇獎留到吃蛋糕那天再說！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll spend Sunday in the garden.
dialogue.zh: 我週日打算待在花園裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: But the weather app says rain.
dialogue.zh: 可是天氣預報說會下雨。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Rain can wait, my plants can't.
dialogue.zh: 雨可以等，我的植物等不了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then wear your big yellow raincoat.
dialogue.zh: 那就穿上你那件大黃雨衣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hey, your mom asked about me?
dialogue.zh: 對了，你媽媽有問起我？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes! She wants your next visit date.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs! ʃi wɑnts jɔr nɛkst ˈvɪzət deɪt/
dialogue.zh: 是啊！她想知道你下次來的日子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tell her I'll bring those almond cookies.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛl hɜr aɪl brɪŋ ðoʊz ˈɑmənd ˈkʊkiz/
dialogue.zh: 告訴她我會帶那些杏仁餅乾。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She'll finish the box before we arrive!
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃil ˈfɪnɪʃ ðə bɑks bɪˈfɔr wi əˈraɪv/
dialogue.zh: 她肯定不等我們到就吃光！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Save me just one cookie, promise?
dialogue.zh: 幫我只留一塊餅乾，好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll try, but no promises!
dialogue.zh: 我試試，但不敢保證！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wave at her tomorrow on our call.
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪv ət hɜr təˈmɑˌroʊ ɑn aʊr kɔl/
dialogue.zh: 明天通話時幫我跟她揮揮手。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will, she'll wave back twice as hard.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl, ʃil weɪv bæk twaɪs æz hɑrd/
dialogue.zh: 我會的，她會更用力地回揮。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You seem a little tired tonight.
dialogue.zh: 你今晚看起來有點累。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I've been busy, but I'm okay.
dialogue.zh: 是忙了一點，但我還好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You should rest more this week.
dialogue.zh: 這週你該多休息一些。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I plan to, starting tomorrow.
dialogue.zh: 我有這打算，從明天開始。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Promises, promises, my friend!
dialogue.zh: 又是保證呀，我的朋友！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: This one I'll really keep.
dialogue.zh: 這次我真的會做到。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I believe you, take care now.
dialogue.zh: 我相信你，好好照顧自己。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You too, don't stay up late.
dialogue.zh: 你也是，別熬夜哦。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll try, though this camera is cruel.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl traɪ, ðoʊ ðɪs ˈkæmərə ɪz ˈkruəl/
dialogue.zh: 我盡量，不過這鏡頭也太殘忍了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mine shows every thought on your face.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪn ʃoʊz ˈɛvri θɔt ɑn jɔr feɪs/
dialogue.zh: 我這鏡頭也把你臉上的心思全拍出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Honest cameras are the worst cameras.
dialogue.zh: 誠實的鏡頭是最壞的鏡頭。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Trust me, mine flatters you tonight.
dialogue.zh: 相信我，我這邊還把你拍好看了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My phone says it's almost midnight.
dialogue.zh: 我手機上顯示快午夜了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It says eleven, look closer.
dialogue.zh: 是十一點啦，湊近看看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh! The clock display is tiny.
dialogue.zh: 噢！時鐘字體太小了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Turn it up, bright and big.
dialogue.zh: 調大它，又亮又大。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thanks, that fixed my panic.
dialogue.zh: 謝了，我的慌張被治好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Panic before bedtime is a habit.
dialogue.zh: 睡前慌張是一種習慣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Time flies when we're on calls.
dialogue.zh: 一打視訊時間就飛快。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It really does, the night is short.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ˈrɪli dʌz, ðə naɪt ɪz ʃɔrt/
dialogue.zh: 真的是，夜晚太短了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My eyes are getting heavy now.
dialogue.zh: 我的眼皮越來越重了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mine too, this calm voice helps.
dialogue.zh: 我也是，這平靜的聲音很助眠。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we end it early tonight?
dialogue.zh: 今晚要不要早點結束？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A few more minutes, please?
dialogue.zh: 再多幾分鐘好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, but no screens after one.
dialogue.zh: 好吧，但一點後不準看螢幕。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Deal, you set the rules well.
dialogue.zh: 成交，你規矩定得不錯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you set your alarm already?
dialogue.zh: 你的鬧鐘設好了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twice, just in case I sleep deep.
dialogue.phonetic: /twaɪs, dʒʌst ɪn keɪs aɪ slip dip/
dialogue.zh: 設了兩個，怕自己睡太沉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I still have one book to read.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ stɪl hæv wʌn bʊk tə rid/
dialogue.zh: 我還有本沒讀完的書。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Read five pages, never the whole thing.
dialogue.phonetic: /rid faɪv ˈpeɪdʒəz, ˈnɛvər ðə hoʊl θɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 讀五頁就好，別想一口氣讀完。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Five pages? That's my nightly goal.
dialogue.zh: 五頁？這正符合我的每晚目標。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Small goals are the ones you keep.
dialogue.phonetic: /smɔl ɡoʊlz ɑr ðə wʌnz ju kip/
dialogue.zh: 小目標才守得住。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What's Saturday's weather in your city?
dialogue.zh: 你那個城市週六天氣如何？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sunny, twelve degrees, jacket day.
dialogue.zh: 晴天，十二度，適合穿外套。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll wear my warm gray jacket then.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl wɛr maɪ wɔrm ɡreɪ ˈdʒækət ðɛn/
dialogue.zh: 那我就穿那件灰色暖外套。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The one I love? Perfect choice.
dialogue.zh: 是我很喜歡的那件嗎？選得好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A walk is nice on a sunny day.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə wɔk ɪz naɪs ɑn ə ˈsʌni deɪ/
dialogue.zh: 晴天上街散散步最舒服。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So let's walk this Saturday, plan it.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ lɛts wɔk ðɪs ˈsætəˌdeɪ, plæn ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 那就這週六約散步，說定吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Saturday morning, the park by you?
dialogue.zh: 週六上午，你家附近那個公園？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect, ten o'clock at the gate.
dialogue.zh: 完美，十點在門口見。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Write it down before you forget.
dialogue.zh: 趕快寫下來別忘了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's in my calendar, twice already.
dialogue.zh: 我日曆裡記了兩次了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, did your cousin arrive okay?
dialogue.zh: 對了，你表妹到了沒？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, safe and sound, thanks for asking.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, seɪf ənd saʊnd, θæŋks fər ˈæskɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 到了，平安無事，謝謝你惦記。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This call has made my whole week.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs kɔl hæz meɪd maɪ hoʊl wik/
dialogue.zh: 這通電話讓我整週都值了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: See? Screen time done right exists.
dialogue.zh: 看見嗎？高品質的螢幕時間是存在的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My phone battery is getting low.
dialogue.zh: 我手機電量有點低了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then this is the right time to stop.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ðɪs ɪz ðə raɪt taɪm tə stɑp/
dialogue.zh: 那剛好是該掛斷的時候。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It's at twelve percent exactly.
dialogue.zh: 電量不多不少剛好百分之十二。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Enough for tomorrow's goodnight text.
dialogue.zh: 夠你明天傳一句晚安訊息。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll put my phone on the charger.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl pʊt maɪ ˈfoʊn ɑn ðə ˈtʃɑrdʒər/
dialogue.zh: 我把手機放上充電器。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: But you just asked for more minutes!
dialogue.phonetic: /bʌt ju dʒʌst æskt fər mɔr ˈmɪnɪts/
dialogue.zh: 你剛剛不是才要多幾分鐘嗎！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Five more minutes, I promise this time.
dialogue.phonetic: /faɪv mɔr ˈmɪnɪts, aɪ ˈprɑməs ðɪs taɪm/
dialogue.zh: 再五分鐘，這次我保證。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Five! I'm counting them now.
dialogue.zh: 五分鐘！我現在開始數。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This talk is better than music.
dialogue.zh: 這番聊天比音樂還好聽。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now who's the flatterer here?
dialogue.zh: 到底誰才是會講話的人？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Time to say goodnight, friend.
dialogue.zh: 是該說晚安的時候了，朋友。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So soon? I wasn't ready yet.
dialogue.zh: 這麼快？我還沒準備好呢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You said that last night too.
dialogue.zh: 你昨晚也是這麼說的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And last week, don't count them.
dialogue.zh: 上週也是，別數了別數了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We laughed the whole call tonight.
dialogue.zh: 今晚我們笑了一整通。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's the best kind of tired.
dialogue.zh: 這是最好的一種疲倦。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My cheeks hurt from smiling now.
dialogue.zh: 我臉頰都笑酸了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Same here, good calls do that.
dialogue.zh: 我也是，好的通話就是有這功效。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I should get into bed soon.
dialogue.zh: 我也該上床休息了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Write to me when you're under the blanket.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt tə mi wɛn jʊr ˈʌndər ðə ˈblæŋkɪt/
dialogue.zh: 鑽進被窩後記得跟我說。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll leave the porch light on.
dialogue.zh: 我會把門口的燈留著。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: For me? I'm just on your screen!
dialogue.phonetic: /fər mi? aɪm dʒʌst ɑn jɔr skriːn/
dialogue.zh: 為我嗎？我不過在你的螢幕裡！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: On the screen, but always real.
dialogue.zh: 在螢幕裡，但一直是真的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now I'm the one getting sleepy.
dialogue.zh: 現在換我開始睏了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Me too, we both need some rest.
dialogue.phonetic: /mi tu, wi boʊθ nid sʌm rɛst/
dialogue.zh: 我也是，我們都該好好休息。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Agreed, no more five more minutes.
dialogue.zh: 同意，不許再「最後五分鐘」。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's call tomorrow at the same time.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛts kɔl təˈmɑˌroʊ ət ðə seɪm taɪm/
dialogue.zh: 明天同一時間再打給我吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect, same hour, same cozy seats.
dialogue.zh: 完美，同一小時，同一個窩。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll take my tea, you keep the coffee.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl teɪk maɪ ti, ju kip ðə ˈkɔfi/
dialogue.zh: 我捧我的茶，你留你的咖啡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Deal, the usual pair again.
dialogue.zh: 成交，老搭檔又上線。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So, should I call or will you?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ, ʃʊd aɪ kɔl ɔr wɪl ju/
dialogue.zh: 所以，明天是我打還是你打？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Either way, I'll keep the ring loud.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈiːðər weɪ, aɪl kip ðə rɪŋ laʊd/
dialogue.zh: 誰打都一樣，鈴聲我會開大聲。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Same time, same app, same place.
dialogue.zh: 同一時間，同一個軟體，同一個位置。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Same two faces, best view.
dialogue.zh: 同樣兩張臉，最好的風景。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And no freezing allowed tomorrow.
dialogue.zh: 明天不準再卡畫面了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll make the wifi promise too.
dialogue.zh: 晚安，好好睡，明天再聊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Goodnight, sweet dreams, talk tomorrow.
dialogue.zh: 晚安，做好夢，明天再聊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nighty night, sleep very well.
dialogue.zh: 晚安呀，要睡得又香又甜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Text me when you wake up.
dialogue.zh: 醒來記得傳訊息給我。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: First thing, before my coffee even.
dialogue.zh: 睜眼第一件事，咖啡都得排隊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Before coffee? That's true love.
dialogue.zh: 咖啡之前？這才是真愛。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Or just a very good habit.
dialogue.zh: 或者只是一個超好的習慣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hang up slowly, take it easy.
dialogue.zh: 掛斷慢一點，別急著按喔。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll wave for three whole seconds.
dialogue.zh: 我會揮手揮滿三秒鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Big wave, big smile, bye-bye.
dialogue.zh: 大力揮手，大力微笑，拜拜。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bye for now, see you on screen.
dialogue.phonetic: /baɪ fər naʊ, si ju ɑn skriːn/
dialogue.zh: 先這樣，螢幕上再見。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Click off, the screen goes dark.
dialogue.zh: 輕輕一點，螢幕暗了下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My room feels quiet all of a sudden.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ rum filz ˈkwaɪət ɔl əv ə ˈsʌdən/
dialogue.zh: 我的房間突然安靜下來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Call me if you dream in English.
dialogue.phonetic: /kɔl mi ɪf ju drim ɪn ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ/
dialogue.zh: 要是夢裡說英文，記得打給我。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then I'll wake you up to report.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn aɪl weɪk ju ʌp tə rɪˈpɔrt/
dialogue.zh: 那我就把你叫醒來匯報。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sleep tight, my favorite face.
dialogue.zh: 睡個好覺，我最愛的那張臉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Goodnight, until tomorrow's ring.
dialogue.zh: 晚安，直到明天鈴聲再響。
